title: Example: panic in database connection pool
body:
## Description

Since upgrading to v1.3.2 the server panics with `ConnectionPool.Acquire` throwing a nil pointer.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Start the server with `--config config/dev.yaml`
2. Send 50 concurrent requests to `/api/health`
3. Observe panic in stderr

## Expected Behavior

Requests should return HTTP 200.

## Environment

- OS: Ubuntu 22.04
- Go version: 1.21.0
- Version: v1.3.2
author: test-user
